name: Moderate AI disruption (to 2030)
description: AI adoption continues at roughly the pace employers reported in the WEF Future of Jobs Survey 2024. Signals are used as they are.
notes: Baseline estimate, not a prediction. The multiplier is a modelling assumption chosen by the LaluanKu team. It leaves signal-based demand unchanged.

name: Fast AI disruption (to 2030)
description: AI adoption speeds up, so demand shifts faster for roles whose tasks are most exposed to AI, in both directions: AI-heavy roles grow faster and routine clerical roles decline faster.
notes: Stress-test estimate, not a prediction. The multiplier is a modelling assumption chosen by the LaluanKu team. It is motivated by evidence of fast-rising task delegation to AI (Anthropic Economic Index, Sept 2025: directive use rose from 27% to 39% in under a year). It is applied in proportion to each role's ai_exposure level.
